name: restore-square
warnings: Known limit of the XRv9k image: its launcher picks the VM disk by file name at every start, and after the first start a second copy of the pristine image sorts first, so the first restart after a deploy boots the device from a fresh disk: it comes back Ready with its factory configuration and everything configured since the deploy is gone (proven on cisco_xrv9k 24.3.1 with containerlab 0.79.0). Back up the configuration first and use Replace running configuration afterwards.
